messages:
elaine: Heads-up — public announce set for Wed at 11:00 PT. Marketing needs: (1) frozen changelog permalink, (2) docs anchor for the rollout details, (3) precise rollout schedule (canary/ramp/global), and (4) final webinar RSVP CTA text. Who can own each?

sam: I can own the changelog and the docs link. Will lock the changelog today and paste permalink here.

pranav: Engineering owns the rollout schedule. Plan is: internal team canary 07:00 PT Wed, 5% external at 11:00 PT (aligned with the announce), regional ramp to 40% by 15:00 PT, full global by 22:00 PT if metrics OK. We'll keep a 45-minute rollback window after each jump.

elaine: Nice — we need the rollback windows in the public-facing runbook? Add an ops note so we can reference it in the incident channel.

pranav: Will add a short ops note. Also: we'll block changes to promo traffic during webinar demo (11:30 PT).

maria: For social linking, use docs anchor id #changes-for-orbit so OG cards point to the right section. Can you add that anchor to the docs intro, @sam?

sam: Yep. Draft changelog is at https://redwood.example.com/changelog/drafts/orbit-2026-03-21 — I'll replace with the permalink when frozen. Docs intro draft and anchor ready locally; will push with changelog freeze.

leo: Perf team: I uploaded benchmark before/after CSVs and PNGs here: https://drive.redwood.com/launch/orbit/perf-snapshots. Bench shows median p95 latency down ~1.6x on steady-state; cost per token ~8% lower with batching/quantization mix.

elaine: Great — marketing will use a single-slide before/after + a short callout for cost. Webinar CTA: "Join our launch webinar to see Orbit in action — register now". Any edits?

maria: Suggest: append "(limited seats)" to encourage signups. Also tagging inbound leads from the webinar: set campaign=orbit23_webinar and route to AE queue orbit-web. Ops — is the webhook endpoint ready?

pranav: Webhook tested in staging. I'll flip to prod after the 5% external canary is stable.

deploy-bot: will post step-by-step updates to #release-war-room. Alerting on any regressions >= P2.

elaine: Final ask — post the frozen changelog URL and the live docs permalink here by 16:00 PT so we can schedule the announcement email and social cards. Also confirm the webinar CTA text by then.

sam: Will post changelog permalink by 15:30 PT.

maria: I'll queue the email drafts and split a follow-up with the perf slides.

elaine: Thanks. We'll do a quick 15-min preflight in #release-war-room 30m before the internal canary. :white_check_mark:
